anomalies.description: A large, sustained fireball with thick dark smoke erupts in the distance behind a fence and tree, consistent with a major explosion (e.g., fuel or chemical tank). The fire remains intense and expanding across all frames.; A large, sustained fireball and plume of smoke erupts from a structure or vehicle in the distance, consistent with a post-explosion fire or ongoing detonation event. The fire intensifies and spreads across frames f0–f15, with visible flame front and rising smoke column.
